_om: Bonden in English (Noughty, rusj.no/en/noughty/): noughts and crosses. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen tegner litt hvor som helst. Fint: The phone draws just about anywhere. Good for little ones.
The phone blocks you – but it can be tricked.
Mobilen taper aldri. Klarer du uavgjort?: The phone never loses. Can you get a draw?
Mobilen tegner litt hvor som helst. Fint: The phone draws just about anywhere. Good for learning.
Mobilen stopper det meste. Passe utfordr: The phone blocks most things. A fair challenge.
Mobilen ser trusler før du gjør det. Lyk: The phone spots threats before you do. Good luck!
Du vinner kampen – først til {n}!: You win the match – first to {n}!
Kryss og bolle: Få tre på rad før motsta: Noughts and crosses: get three in a row before your opponent does. Or try five in a row on the big board.
Trykk på en tom rute. Den ene tegner kry: Tap an empty square. One of you draws crosses, the other noughts.
Få tre like etter hverandre – bortover,: Get three of your marks in a line – across, down or diagonally. On the big board you need five.
Har den andre to på rad og en ledig rute: Has the other player got two in a row and a free square? Take that square before it's too late!
Midten er sterk, og hjørnene er nesten l: The middle is strong, and the corners are nearly as good.
Lag to trusler på en gang, så klarer ikk: Make two threats at once, and your opponent can't block both.
Fem på rad: Fire på rad med ledig plass: Five in a row: four in a row with a free space at both ends can't be stopped.
Det store brettet, 15 × 15, er det klass: The big board, 15 × 15, is the classic board for five in a row. There's room for long, open games.
Først til 3: Den som først vinner tre ru: First to 3: whoever wins three rounds first wins the match. Choose ‘No end’ if you just want to keep playing.
Fem på rad på en liten skjerm: Trykk én: Five in a row on a small screen: tap once to see a faint mark, and once more to draw it.
Uslåelig-nivået taper aldri. Klarer du u: The Unbeatable level never loses. Can you get a draw?
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Du tegner kryss. Du og mobilen bytter på: You draw crosses. You and the phone take turns to start.
Player 1 draws crosses, player 2 noughts. You take turns to start.
Den som først vinner {n} runder, vinner: Whoever wins {n} rounds first wins the match.
Dere spiller så mange runder dere vil, o: Play as many rounds as you like, and stop whenever you like.
Uslåelig er uslåelig! Men uavgjort er og: Unbeatable is unbeatable! But a draw is quite an achievement too.
Godt kjempa! Prøv igjen – du blir bedre: Well fought! Try again – you get better every round.
Uavgjort mot Uslåelig – det er så godt d: A draw against Unbeatable – that's as good as it gets!
Like mange seirer hver. Det får avgjøres: The same number of wins each. It'll have to be settled next time!
Vent litt – mobilen tenker: Hang on – the phone is thinking
Dere går til kåringen. Stillingen er {st: You'll go to the results. The score is {stilling}.
You can always start a new one.
